properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 9:48PM MDT until August 9 at 10:30PM MDT by NWS Goodland KS

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 11:00PM CDT until August 10 at 1:15AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
At 1100 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
that thunderstorms were moving out of the area and rain rates were
decreasing. Up to 3 inches of rain occurred between Lee Center and
Ashton due to earlier storms.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Rapid-onset flooding of creeks, streams, drainage ditches,
streets, underpasses, low-lying areas, and other poor
drainage areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Amboy, Franklin Grove, Paw Paw, Lee, Compton, Steward, West
Brooklyn and Lee Center.
properties.instruction:
A Flash Flood Warning means rapid-onset flooding is imminent or may
already be occurring. Persons along creeks, drainage ditches, and
other waterways should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 8:43PM MST until August 10 at 12:45AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
FFWPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Maricopa County in south central Arizona...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1245 AM MST.

* At 843 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen. Significant runoff into Vekol
Wash is expected or ongoing. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Freeman.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Vekol Wash, Kohatk Wash, Kaka Wash and Waterman Wash.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 12:45 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 12:45 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Morgan County in north central Alabama...
West Central Marshall County in northeastern Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 1115 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

thunderstorms. Lingering flooding will continue to subside over

fell earlier this evening. Please continue to heed any road
closures!

Arab, Falkville, Morgan City, Somerville, Eva, Union Grove,
Florette, Ryan Crossroads, Valhermoso Springs, Hulaco, Laceys
Spring, Eddy, Cole Springs and Lacon.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 9 at 9:46PM CDT until August 10 at 12:45AM CDT by NWS Huntsville AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Madison County in north central Alabama...

* WHEN...Until 1245 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 942 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges measured 2
to 3" of rainfall in about half an hour earlier this evening,
with rainfall totals between 3-4" estimated in portions of
Northern and Western Huntsville. Local creeks in the city rose
several feet in an hour as a result. Indian Creek at Madison also
rose 4 feet during this time, and it continues to slowly rise.
Indian Creek should crest between 7 and 8 feet around or after
midnight, and slowly fall through sunrise.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Huntsville, Madison, Redstone Arsenal, Triana, Marshall Space
Flight Center, University Of Alabama In Huntsville, Huntsville
International Airport and Alabama A And M University.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued August 9 at 10:58PM CDT until August 9 at 11:45PM CDT by NWS Lincoln IL
properties.description:
At 1057 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Brimfield, or 13 miles west of Peoria, moving east
at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is
likely.

This dangerous storm will be near...
Peoria around 1110 PM CDT.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include Peoria
Heights, Norwood, Mossville, Kickapoo, Jubilee College State Park,
and Alta.

This also includes Jubilee College State Park and Rock Island Trail
State Park.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 474 between mile markers 0 and 8.
Interstate 74 between mile markers 74 and 93.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Tornadoes are extremely difficult to see and confirm at night. Do not
wait to see or hear the tornado. TAKE COVER NOW!
